The date is the real problem: FID guidance has slipped twice in nine months (mid-2026 to late-2026 to Q1 2027 per the 2026-07-29 deck), so "a hard, dated gate" is not what this is; the only hard date is the November 2026 bridge-runway cliff, which forces a dilutive raise into the catalyst rather than paying out from it. On residual capture the tape has already moved 41% off the late-July low into the "imminent announcement" window, leaving ~29% to a waterfall-derived $5.50 against ~35% downside, and the waterfall itself shows why: the equity tranche must be sold at the Kabanga project level, cutting Lifezone's 84% to roughly half before common holders see any of the $1.58B. Score capped at 4 on both the mostly-harvested run-up and the absence of any cleared gate; revisit only if the partner is actually named with a signed Framework Agreement and a firm FID date, at which point the risk shifts from "does it fund" to "at what price it funded."

verified.primary_source: Veradermics PR/8-K "Completes Enrollment in Second Pivotal Phase 3 Clinical Trial of VDPHL01" (businesswire, 2026-02-09) and "Oral VDPHL01 Achieved Early, Consistent, and Robust Hair Growth in Positive Phase 2/3 '302' Trial" (ir.veradermics.com, 2026-04-27); price/valuation FMP quote + EOD chart (2026-09-04 close $98.51) and Q2-2026 balance sheet (period ending 2026-06-30)
verified.analysis: The event is real, dated and genuinely forward — 304 has not read out — but it is confirmatory, not informative: the same drug at the same two doses already hit all primary and key secondary endpoints at high statistical significance in the 519-patient Study '302' (topline 2026-04-27), which is what re-rated the stock from $67.84 to $100.10 in a session. Numerator provenance is clean and does not constrain the case: the Q2-2026 balance sheet (2026-06-30) shows zero preferred stock, $0.43M of capital-lease debt as total debt and $819.9M cash+short-term investments (~$19.6/sh on ~41.8M shares), with APIC up from $543M to $989M — i.e. the post-302 raise is already done, common takes 100% of any value, and there is no waterfall leakage or near-term financing overhang. The disqualifier is residual capture, not deal quality: the stock is already 25% below its July high, has given back the entire 302 follow-through, and a clean 304 buys back roughly the prior peak while a miss or an oral-minoxidil safety signal costs ~half — so I score the remaining asymmetry, cap at 4, and hold WATCH rather than the triage's 5. Gap: the 2H-2026 window has no fixed date and I did not confirm the exact 304 primary-endpoint week (302's design implies a ~24-week primary, pointing to a Q4-2026 print).
